jobs.title: Environmental Science Expert (Masters/PhDs)
jobs.description:
Environmental Science Expert (AI Training)

About The Role

What if your expertise in climate modeling, ecology, or sustainability could directly shape how AI understands and reasons about the most pressing environmental challenges facing our planet? We're looking for Environmental Science experts to develop and review advanced, real-world problems that teach AI systems to think with genuine scientific rigor.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for researchers and advanced degree holders who want to put their domain expertise to meaningful use — on their own schedule.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Design, solve, and review complex environmental science problems with real-world relevance — spanning climate modeling, ecology, sustainability, and related disciplines
Apply your advanced domain knowledge to craft challenging, nuanced problem statements that push AI reasoning to its limits
Evaluate AI-generated outputs for scientific accuracy, depth, and rigor
Collaborate asynchronously with AI researchers and fellow domain experts to refine and improve model performance
Ensure clarity, precision, and intellectual integrity across all deliverables
Work independently on task-based assignments fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

Hold a Master's or PhD in Environmental Science or a closely related field
Deep expertise in at least one of: climate modeling, ecology, environmental sustainability, or adjacent areas
Proficient in Python or R for research, data analysis, or scientific computing
Exceptional written communicator — you can translate complex science into clear, well-structured problem statements
Detail-oriented, rigorous, and comfortable working independently
Fluent in English and based in the U.S., Canada, U.K., Australia, or New Zealand

Nice to Have

Prior experience with data annotation, data labeling, or AI evaluation workflows
Background in interdisciplinary research spanning environmental science and quantitative modeling
Experience designing curriculum, assessments, or research problems in an academic or professional setting
Familiarity with AI tools or large language model capabilities

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, expert-level work
Make a direct impact on how AI understands environmental science and reasons about climate and ecology
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
